description: Everything one New York public authority has issued: every bond and debt issue with its terms, plus totals by fiscal year and a breakdown of new money versus refunding. Answers "how much has the Dormitory Authority borrowed", "what has Battery Park City Authority issued and at what interest cost", "is this issuer mostly refinancing". Covers primary-market issuance only — no reported trade prices.

authority.description: Authority name, matched loosely, e.g. "Battery Park City".
